decisions.reason: ACE3 is a core ALCMS control platform in the firm's airfield business, where installed bases and lifecycles run long, so withdrawal within a year is very unlikely.
The air situation display complements the tower and surveillance portfolio and the integrated operations strategy, though its lower prominence leaves some risk of being merged into other offerings.
The airport systems training program supports the firm's service business and costs little to maintain, so it is likely to continue, possibly reorganized under its training offer.
Airfield ground lighting training is tied to the firm's core AGL installed base and maintenance services, so it stays relevant even if it is folded into broader training catalogs.

The collaboration software fits the firm's push toward collaborative decision-making and data-driven integrated operations, though software tools are sometimes rebranded or consolidated into larger suites.
The MLAT surveillance system was launched as a flagship and fits the firm's move toward integrated surveillance and tower solutions, so dropping it soon after launch is unlikely.
